items.title: Witch Weaving a Basket
items.alt: A seated witch weaves the broad rim of a basket with two long strips.
items.description: A seated witch weaves the broad rim of a small basket on her lap, two long flexible strips held apart in her hands. Use this illustration for craft and making activities and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Examining a Crystal
items.alt: A witch examines a purple crystal through a magnifying glass.
items.description: A curious witch holds a magnifying glass over one faceted purple crystal on a plain shallow tray. Use this illustration for observation and shape activities and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Resting on a Cushion
items.alt: A witch rests cross-legged on a round cushion with her pointed hat beside her.
items.description: A peaceful witch sits upright cross-legged on one round cushion, hands relaxed on knees and hat laid beside the cushion. Use this illustration for calm fantasy scenes and personal crafts.
